title: Short request at admission cutover
requiredVisibleLabel: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Distinguish a legitimate v1 completion from a separate v2 admission while preserving original request and journey budgets, state and correct response.
preconditions: A browser capable of standard local HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
Fixed synthetic clock, one synthetic journey and two synthetic requests.
No account, subscription, server, credentials or application framework.
actions: Choose safe, unsafe or invalid-evidence presets.
Change bounded synthetic timing and original budget controls.
Inspect identity-bound request results and the ordered synthetic trace.
Check a prediction separately from user impact.
Edit synthetic JSON or Reset to the exact safe fixture.
assertions: Admission before cutover belongs to v1; admission at or after cutover belongs to v2.
Old work is not silently transferred and its late v1 completion is legitimate.
Request and journey deadlines are original, independent and inclusive.
Incorrect response, lost state, budget breach and premature retirement are interruptions.
Absent or invalid evidence stays unknown and cannot authorize retirement.
No request-level observation proves that a user moved.

iac.decisionStage: After genuine behavioral red; before implementation
iac.reason: Resource-free local lesson. No cloud or IaC generation, deployment, identity, expenditure or production-runtime approval is implied.

limits: All clocks, traffic, users, state and response evidence are synthetic.
No actual HTTP, Azure, routing, latency, drain or state-continuity assertion.
User migration remains unknown; no migration success percentage.
B-S041 and original D-S041 native acceptance remain separate and unfulfilled.
No cloud, IaC, package, global runtime or shared-file changes.
